frames.eci: Earth-centred inertial (SGP4 TEME, treat as J2000 for display); km; X to vernal equinox, Z to north pole
frames.quaternion: q_body_to_eci = [x, y, z, w], scalar LAST, Hamilton; rotates body vectors into ECI (use as the satellite's rotation in an ECI-aligned scene)
frames.ecef_from_eci: rotate about ECI Z by earth.gmst_deg

body_axes.+Y: cross-track; +Y solar wing; solar-array-drive rotation axis
body_axes.+Z: nadir (points at Earth in nominal attitude); imager boresight
body_axes.-Z: zenith; zenith star camera and GPS antenna

solar_wings.note: each wing = 2 folding 209x342 mm panels; hinged at the +/-Y face, folded flat against it when STOWED

sada.cell_normal_body: (cos a, 0, sin a) with a = deploy.sada_angle_deg; when tracking, a = atan2(sun_z, sun_x) in body axes

antenna.suggested_model: 4 tape-spring UHF elements ~0.5 m, on the -Z (zenith) face corners, flush when STOWED
antenna.note: suggestion only; the simulator models deployment state, not element geometry

power_fields: power: bus_voltage_v; generated_w, consumed_w, net_w (W); wings.wing_py/wing_my {current_a, power_w, deployed}, wings.sada_angle_deg; body_faces.px..mz {current_a, power_w} (smo-vr/1 body axes, wings excluded); strings.a/b {voltage_v, current_a, enabled}; battery {soc_pct, voltage_v, current_a (+ = charging), charging, temp_c}; load_shed_stage 0-3
